name: Pear (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Pear (Pyrus communis) [Fruits] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: A. Escarpa and M. C. Gonzalez. Evaluation of High-Performance Liquid Chromatography for Determination of Phenolic Compounds in Pear Horticultural Cultivars. Chromatographia Vol. 51, No. 1/2, January 2000, 37-43, DTU, DUKE, Dilek Tanrioven and Aziz Eksi. Phenolic compounds in pear juice from different cultivars. Food Chemistry. 2005, 93(1), 89-93, P. B. Andrade, A. R. F. Carvalho, R. M. Seabra, and M. A. Ferreira. A Previous Study of Phenolic Profiles of Quince, Pear, and Apple Purees by HPLC Diode Array Detection for the Evaluation of Quince Puree Genuineness. J. Agric. Food Chem., 1998, 46 (3), pp 968-972. DOI: 10.1021/jf970571j, PHENOL EXPLORER, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 169118 (Pears, raw; SR Legacy full nutrient panel via nutritionvalue.org)
Radovic et al. 2022, Foods, PMC9563278 (sugars & organic acids of 10 Pyrus communis cultivars)
Zhang et al. 2022, J. Food Composition and Analysis, doi:10.1016/j.jfca.2022.104481 (organic acids in 193 Pyrus cultivars)
Aprifel nutritional sheets (Conference & Williams pear individual sugars incl. sorbitol)
provenance.curation_notes: Dominant carbon/energy sources for a microbe growing on pear are fructose (~6.4 g/100g) then sorbitol (~1.8 g/100g) and glucose (~2.6 g/100g), with malic acid (~0.12 g/100g) the leading organic acid. Sorbitol and all organic acids were absent from the FooDB profile and were the main growth-relevant additions; 21 non-nutritive contaminants/implausible compounds were removed.
curation_added: individual free sugars with real amounts (fructose 6.42, glucose 2.60, sucrose 0.71 g/100g)
vitamin K1, choline, pantothenic acid, selenium, fluoride quantified

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
